tw: Foolish Kron fishes in the school pool, and a cool fish fishes him out.
twc: 傻乎乎的 Kron 在学校泳池钓鱼，一条酷鱼反把他钓了上去。

tw: Grandpa Kron's grandchildren build a grand sand stand on his chilly chin.
twc: Kron 爷爷的孙子孙女们在他冰凉的下巴上堆了座大沙台。

tw: Kron pushes to move away a moose, but the moose moves his grey sofa away.
twc: Kron 使劲想把驼鹿推走，驼鹿却把他的灰沙发挪走了。
hint: 要搬走的没走，沙发走了。

tw: "What happened?" asks Kron, as a happy hen hops out of his hat.
twc: “出什么事了？”Kron 问，一只开心的母鸡从他帽子里蹦出来。
hint: 问出了啥事，事就在头上。

tw: Kron must climb up a lime tree in time to catch nine limes in his cup.
twc: Kron 爬上青柠树，刚好用杯子接住了九个青柠。

tw: Kron has to hold onto an old goat's gold coat on top of a toboggan.
twc: Kron 坐在雪橇上，死死抓住一只老山羊的金色外套。

tw: A fly helps Kron's kite fly away, and Kron flies high on the string.
twc: 一只苍蝇帮 Kron 的风筝飞走，Kron 挂在线上一起飞高。

tw: On the Bund, Kron holds a bundle of buns, and a hundred gulls stare.
twc: Kron 在外滩抱着一大包包子，一百只海鸥直勾勾地盯着。

tw: Kron sang, hanging high in the Shanghai Museum, and his music amuses the museum mums.
twc: Kron 高高吊在上海博物馆里唱歌，逗乐了一群参观的妈妈们。
hint: 博物馆里最好看的展品是他。

tw: Kron skates the Great Wall with eight tall balls, and all eight fall.
twc: Kron 踩着溜冰鞋在长城上顶着八个高高的球，八个全掉了。

tw: At the Summer Palace, Kron and pal Alice hum while rowing the stone boat.
twc: 在颐和园，Kron 和好朋友爱丽丝哼着歌划石舫。

tw: Kron flashes a fishing-net hat at the fashion show and shows off his toes.
twc: Kron 在时装秀上戴着渔网帽亮相，还炫了一把脚趾头。

tw: Kron throws a coin so his show will go well, and the well throws it back.
twc: Kron 往井里扔硬币求演出顺利，井把硬币扔了回来。

tw: In heavy rain, seven ducks jump on Kron's train, and the train goes again.
twc: 下大雨，七只鸭子跳上 Kron 的小火车，火车又开起来了。

tw: Then and now: then Kron held ten hens, and now ten hens hold Kron. Wow!
twc: 以前 Kron 抱着十只鸡，现在十只鸡抬着 Kron，哇！

tw: To do shopping, Kron hops on a hopping pogo stick and can't stop in the shop.
twc: Kron 踩着蹦蹦跳跳的弹簧高跷去购物，在店里停不下来。
hint: 购物车不用，弹簧杆停不了。

tw: Kron tells a slow snail, "Go on, go on!", and the snail goes on Kron's nose.
twc: Kron 催慢吞吞的蜗牛“继续走！”，蜗牛就爬到了他鼻子上。
hint: 让它继续，它继续到脸上。

tw: Kron asks a grey jay on the hay, "What day is today?"
twc: Kron 问干草堆上的灰松鸦：“今天星期几？”

tw: Kron tries to make a sentence with ten tents, but a snake takes the end tent.
twc: Kron 想用十顶帐篷排成一个句子，蛇把最后一顶拖走了。

tw: Kron plays ping-pong with a mop in the centre of the shopping centre.
twc: Kron 在购物中心正中间拿拖把打乒乓球。
hint: 拖把当球拍，商场当球台。
